arguments.decision: How should this macOS arm64 static pipeline recover exact ROMDIR boundaries for the measured IOPRP255.IMG?

candidates.description: Write a bounds-checked local reader of the observed 16-byte ROMDIR entries, with name validation and ELF section/program bounds; use pinned ps2img source as layout evidence.
Build and execute unmodified pinned ps2img on this image.
Port legacy ps2img pointer and implicit declaration code to 64-bit modern Clang, then run it.

arguments.evidence: Pinned ps2img 017018224a8a77a79bf57f387bbcea3f4505c8f0 common.h romdir_t is char name[10], unsigned short extinfo_size, int size. ximg.c starts modules at PAD16(romdir[1].size+romdir[2].size) and advances PAD16(each module size). Its entries[i].irx_binary = (char*)(elf_offset+(int)img) narrows pointer to 32 bits. Modern Clang build failed two implicit declaration errors. Measured image starts RESET size0, ROMDIR size304, EXTINFO size560, then 15 named modules; first ELF at864. Header-only inventory found those 15 exact sequential ELF candidates, but has not validated full section spans against module lengths.
arguments.priorities: Offline only; preserve original payloads; exact evidence and failure boundaries; no host pointer corruption; no GUI or emulator. Prefer small grounded reusable verifier over unrelated broad porting.
requirements: Works on 64-bit arm64 host without narrowing pointers.
Derives lengths from directory entries rather than next-magic guesses.

policy: Preserve full result; independent deterministic/source review required for non-auto; no threshold changes.
